beats.name: hook
beats.said: A man loads gold into a shotgun and blasts it at the mine's walls.
beats.shown: Spotlit miner; fast fly-in to face and shotgun breech, nugget dropped in, wink, muzzle flash; cut to the nugget streaking into rock; slow pull-out.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Buddy watches gold sink into rock; narrator voices the objection: why plant gold in a gold mine?
beats.shown: Buddy on a stool with a mug in an amber alcove; faces swap from bored to toothy grin to wide-eyed; golden cracks glow in the rock.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: It is called salting: the miner has dug ten years for nothing and a rich buyer arrives tomorrow.
beats.shown: Miner in a rock tunnel, a sunlit yard with ore cart and pebbles, then miner and buddy holding up a newspaper headline.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: He spends his last hundred on gold dust; the buyer arrives next morning and bumps his head.
beats.shown: Shop counter with a 100 bill and gold dust, dissolve to a white car in a pine valley, gate sign, buyer's hat squashes on a beam.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: The buyer has brought an expert who smashes a wall chunk and pans it with gold flakes spinning.
beats.shown: Expert at the gate, swings a pickaxe at a rock wall, pans a sample over a barrel, macro of flakes swirling.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: A magnifier shows flat flakes: the gold was shot in. The buyer laughs it off; the buddy agrees.
beats.shown: Fly through a magnifying lens to a dark macro of a flat flake, gold pile dissolve, buyer laughing in a plank room, miner and buddy nod.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: The buyer pays and the two flee; he stays, lights dynamite, hurls it into the tunnel and runs.
beats.shown: Cash on a table, buddy runs off with bills, buyer alone with a dynamite stick, fuse sparks, throw down a tunnel, dark run to the gate.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: The dust settles on a fat seam of genuine gold, ten feet beyond where the last miner quit.
beats.shown: Dust fills the frame and fades to a golden vein; dusty buyer smiles; camera pulls out to chalk 10 FT and the miner's hat on a pick.

hook.first_frame: Full-body miner in a brown wide-brim lamp hat and red plaid vest stands centred on rail tracks in a dark tunnel, shotgun held diagonally, under a ceiling lamp's light cone; caption 'He' already on screen.
hook.first_3s: Static hold with dust motes (0-0.5 s); fast fly-in to face, nugget dropped into the breech, wink down the barrels (0.5-1.9 s); muzzle flash, hard cut at 2.0 s to a nugget streaking into rock beside the buddy.
hook.first_frame_subject: protagonist posing with the key prop
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title names the topic (mine salting); the first line shows the act without naming it, so the term is only explained at 9.1 s.

story.real_fact_core: Mine salting: scammers plant real gold, here shot into walls by shotgun, to fake a rich vein; a magnifier shows the planted flakes are flat.
story.protagonist: Down-on-his-luck prospector in a brown wide-brim hat who salts his own worthless mine, with his buddy in a yellow beanie.
story.authority_or_antagonist: The rich buyer in a white suit (the mark) and a bowler-hatted assay expert who inspects the gold.
story.ending_type: twist reveal is the last line

tone.humour: Slapstick and reaction gags (hat flattens on the beam, wide-eye and toothy faces) on an absurd premise; irony that the reckless buyer finds a real vein.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Deadpan narrator voicing the viewer's disbelief in one rhetorical question; dramatic irony at the end: the hoax fails, real gold sat ten feet further.
tone.dialogue_style: One narrator voice covers everyone; only about 3 short quoted lines (a rhetorical question and two reaction lines), with the speaking character's mouth animated (estimate).

character_style.outline: Uniform thick near-black outline (about 6-8 px at 1080 wide, estimate) on every character part; set and props have no outline.
character_style.shading: Flat white faces with a faint warm gradient; hats, jacket and rose carry soft 3D-style shading and highlights; scene light tints the characters.
character_style.consistency_between_shots: Very high: same faces, hat shapes, colours and outline weight in every shot; only expression sprites and pose change.

animation.body_motion: Pose-to-pose rig motion in a 3D scene: arms, torso and head tilt between held poses; limbs bend like rubber hose; characters walk or slide into frame (f692); big gags are short keyed tilts.
animation.eyes_and_blinks: Eyes swap between a few drawn states (dots, flat half-lids, wide circles, arcs, X); a thin-line frame at f246 may be a blink; no regular blink rhythm confirmed (estimate).
animation.idle_motion: Held poses stay nearly still; heads sway or bob a few percent with speech and laughter (f1164-f1197, f204-f270); slow camera push-in of 1-4 %/s and drifting sparks add life.
animation.squash_and_stretch: On impact gags only: top hat flattens to a disc and recovers in about 0.3 s while the head tilts 40-45 degrees (f653-f677); otherwise rigid shapes.

Glides along the rock wall from the embedded nugget out to the seated buddy in 0.7 s, then a near-static drift for 4.8 s.

generation_evidence.observation: Camera glides through a gold magnifier ring; tunnel, rails, lantern and cart keep rigid perspective while the ring shows real thickness and highlights.
Gate sign text SURE THING MINE / EST. 1899 stays crisp and unchanged through an 18-frame take; bunting, rails and pillars hold perspective; the sign returns at f1360.
Newspaper masthead, headline, dateline and ads stay sharp and identical while the page scales and shifts; the portrait matches the cartoon buyer, so it is a designed texture, not generated text.
Faces are flat drawn sprites swapped between a small set of mouth and eye shapes at about 0.2 s steps while head, beanie and outline stay identical.
Hat flattens to a disc and snaps back, head tilts 45 degrees and the body bends within 0.5 s while hard cast shadows on the set stay consistent: a keyed rig lit in the scene.
A 2.2 s continuous path follows a thrown dynamite stick; cart, timbers, rails and sparks keep consistent geometry, and the cart and gate props recur in other shots.

Whether the dust cloud at 54-57 s is a 3D volume or stock smoke footage.
